Came to know about this tour company from locals (word of mouth), mostly from Marathi spraking senior citizens. Explored with them available tours, decided to give it a try on Saputara 3 day tour (even through price/cost quote seemed very high at that time), mostly for pleasure of my elderly mother. It turned out to be hit and miss. Some things worked well, some didn't -

A) What worked well -

Many things/aspects -
1) planning,
2) their experience in travel industry,
3) payment,
4) communication from them during planning and actual trip,
5) mostly good food/meals throughout 3 days
6) decent good logistics and instructions,
7) reasonably good accommodation,
8) comfortable bus,
9) variety content during tour (places, activities),
10) mostly good care of senior citizen needs,
11) family/homely atmosphere throughout
12) Photo/Video capture and sharing
13) Going extra mile for satisfying some specific non standard needs of certain tourists (elderly/handicapped tourists).

I sincerely appreciate whatever tour owners did for all above.

B) What didn't work well (for us) -

1) Rude behavior by tour owners - 2 times they claimed and told us something that was absolutely contradicting with 10s of unbiased unrelated people (taxi drivers, market vendors, other tourists) told us and many our fellow tourists in our tour. In important aspects of tour from comfort and content perspective. Especially for physically challenged senior citizens. featured_reviews.review_text:
My family has travelled via Parshv Holidays multiple times and hence when my mom wanted to send my brother and I on a siblings trip abroad, they knew Bhavesh uncle was the right choice.

He recommended us a beautiful, yet to be explored by Indian tourists and unique country- Jordan. The itinerary was customised, flexible and a lot of time to explore on our own when we wanted to. There were many unique places that were unexplored by many tourists such as Um Qais, Shobak castle and Madaba. We had wonderful times walking through cities built 3000 years ago and excavated recently.  We explored Petra, Jerash, Aqaba, Amman and Dead Sea.

He personally called us daily to make sure the trip was smooth. The driver had immense knowledge about the history and entire country. The chefs of the restaurant were informed to prepare special vegetarian meals for us.
Being on a trip on our own for the first time felt easy because all the reservations and services were conducted smoothly and taken care of by Bhavesh uncle beforehand.

He was very patient and wasn't rushing around, which helped my parent's other members travel hassle-free. They ensured the itinerary was perfectly tailored to their interests and preferences, with an outstanding balance of activities and relaxation time.

One thing that really stood out to my parents was the availability of the owner Manan Shah, who was always accessible and willing to assist with any concerns they had during the trip. This level of personalised service and attention to detail truly made their experience with Nomadic Globe exceptional.

Moreover, the quality of the hotels provided by Nomadic Globe was impressive. They stayed at 5-star hotels throughout the trip, which added to the overall comfort and luxury of their experience. And the best part is that despite the high-quality hotels, Nomadic Globe offered very competitive and cheap rates, making it accessible to a broader range of travellers.

As a concerned daughter, I was worried about my parents' safety and comfort while traveling alone, especially since they both suffered from leg pains. However, the team at Nomadic Globe and the owner reassured me that I didn't have to worry and would be taken care of, and true to their words, they went above and beyond to ensure that my parents had a comfortable and stress-free trip. They provided them with comfortable vehicles, accommodations, and planned activities suitable for their physical limitations. The team also proactively addressed issues during the journey, ensuring my parents felt supported and cared for.

Thanks to the beautiful team at Nomadic Globe, my parents had an incredible time in Nepal. I highly recommend Nomadic Globe to anyone looking for a safe, comfortable, and stress-free travel experience, with the added bonus of affordable luxury. Thank you, Nomadic Globe, for taking such good care of my parents and their fellow travellers from the USA!
